mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in prior 3 months but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% in a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in 3 months but S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market (PAYEMS growth >0.5% MoM) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL >325) signals overheating that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth >0.5% MoM and CPIAUCSL >325 but S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL >325), a federal funds rate increase above 3.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL >325 and FEDFUNDS rises >3.5% but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicates robust consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: HOUST increases in prior 3 months but S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales exceeding 750,000 in a 3-month average signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS exceeds 750,000 in 3 months but S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market (HOUST >1500) combined with low industrial production (INDPRO <100) signals persistent supply chain constraints that reduce corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST >1500 and INDPRO <100 but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During low industrial production regimes (INDPRO <100), the S&P 500 underperforms due to weak manufacturing activity and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 100 for 3 months but S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in >55% of instances.
